title: Missed Patient Calls: Clinic Callback Owner Path
audience: Clinic owners, practice managers and front-office operators
search_phrases: why is my clinic missing calls
answer: Choose one safe time window, reconcile the aggregate missed-call signal, assign a callback owner and backup, record status, and test a reversible workflow change before buying an AI receptionist or automation tool.
